# units-dimensional

> Parse quantities such as 9.81 m/s^2 and convert them between units with exact dimensional analysis over SI base dimensions Python package `trysac-units-dimensional`, import name `units_dimensional`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
